current_source_reconstruction.Te_semantics: average soil temperature per model compartment; internal Temper.for evaluates temperature at compartment midpoint; hydrological input supplies Te(1:Nl) and Te(0)=Avdate
current_source_reconstruction.root_state: Nuroup is runtime deepest active root/transpiration compartment index; SWATRE root routines reset it to zero and set it to deepest Ln with Flev(Ln)>=1e-7
current_source_reconstruction.Te50_source_statement: Te50 = Te(Ln) after both root-zone DO loops
current_source_reconstruction.zero_root_effect: fGrow is evaluated from Te(1), but K1plant is zero for all compartments because no compartment satisfies Ln<=LnRoot
current_source_reconstruction.separate_soil_methane_temperature: CH4produc consumes local Te(Ln); this is distinct from Te50 used only by plant-growth multiplier

animo_specific_evidence.finding: Plant-mediated CH4 transport is explicit; Te50 drives fGrow; local variable is literally named Te50; Kpl=0.24 d-1; source contains no comment defining Te50 depth or selector rule.
Tegr is documented as temperature at which plant starts to grow; FvegCH4 is vegetation factor; PvCH4Ox is fraction oxidised during plant transport.

animo_specific_evidence.source: ANIMO 4.0 User Guide, temperature and hydrology input sections
animo_specific_evidence.finding: Te is soil temperature by layer in degC; the guide predates the later GHG selector and does not define Te50.
Nuroup and Te ownership/indexing are reconstructable, but no 0.50 m lookup/interpolation authority exists in the reviewed frozen source.
Recovered ANIMO-specific GHG theory is strong for N2O but does not supply the missing CH4 plant-growth selector identity.

external_evidence.citation: Walter, B.P. & Heimann, M. (2000), Global Biogeochemical Cycles 14(3), 745-765, DOI 10.1029/1999GB001204
external_evidence.finding: Walter-Heimann plant-mediated CH4 transport uses kp=0.01 h-1, vegetation factor, root distribution and fGrow; fGrow is based on daily mean soil temperature at 50 cm depth T50, with Amin=0, Amax=4, Tmat=Tgr+10 C.

external_evidence.citation: Hendriks, Wollewinkel & van den Akker (2007), SWAP-ANIMO peat GHG conference contribution
external_evidence.finding: Confirms ANIMO GHG development lineage and process-based CH4 model but the accessible four-page contribution does not define the disputed Te50 selector.

external_evidence.citation: Wageningen/Netherlands GHG synthesis referencing SWAP-ANIMO and Walter-Heimann
external_evidence.finding: Independent contextual evidence states the CH4 modelling lineage includes a version of the Walter-Heimann model; this is not revision-53 selector authority.

matches: Kpl 0.24 d-1 equals Walter-Heimann kp 0.01 h-1
FvegCH4 corresponds structurally to vegetation transport factor
fGrow functional form has same 0-to-4 envelope
PvCH4Ox corresponds to rhizospheric/plant-path oxidation fraction
ANIMO local variable name Te50 matches Walter-Heimann T50
provenance_fingerprint.inference: The ANIMO plant-growth multiplier is very likely adapted from the Walter-Heimann plant-mediated methane formulation and its conceptual temperature quantity is therefore strongly supported as daily mean soil temperature at 0.50 m depth.
provenance_fingerprint.limit: Under this workunit evidence hierarchy, external literature is NEW_MODEL_EVOLUTION_SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE and cannot by itself establish historical ANIMO intent. More importantly, no reviewed ANIMO authority defines how T(0.50 m) maps to arbitrary layer-centered Te indices.
